title: Strict integral completion agrees with the source completion
statement: Fix a prime ell, a scheme W, the derived categories and a simultaneous integral reduction I as in [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface], and any total right derived inverse limit RZ with its universal comparison. Let E identify abelian sheaves with sheaves of modules over the lifted integers, and let H be the source completion for the ideal generated by ell, constructed in [lem-sfb-source-principal-completion-adjunction]. There is a natural isomorphism (I.T followed by RZ) followed by the derived coefficient equivalence E, to E followed by H. This asserts only comparison of models, with no unit, orthogonality or Hom universal property.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion; derived completion by the derived inverse limit of finite reductions

proof.text: The strict integral limit has derived-complete values after the coefficient equivalence. Obtain its natural augmentation whose cone has invertible prime action. These two statements keep the strict quotient, its transitions and the total-derived comparisons; neither asserts the comparison with the reflector.

For every complete target, the triangle exact sequence and orthogonality to prime-invertible objects make precomposition by the strict augmentation bijective. Use the source completion adjunction to factor that augmentation through the source completion. The Hom bijections show this factor is an isomorphism in the full subcategory of complete objects. Uniqueness of adjoint factorization proves naturality. Taking its inverse gives exactly the asserted natural comparison. This is implemented by the proved private comparison_of_complete_and_triangle helper.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099M, principal completion via complete values and augmentation cone; actual Lean gluing uses the source adjunction and triangle orthogonality

lean.statement:
theorem integral_strict_completion_comparison (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W)]
    (I : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (𝟭 (DiagonalAb W)))
    (RZ : DerivedCategory (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W) ⥤ DerivedCategory (DiagonalAb W))
    (ηZ : (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W) ⥤ DiagonalAb W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ RZ)
    (hRZ : RZ.IsRightDerivedFunctor ηZ
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W) (.up ℤ))) :
    Nonempty ((I.T ⋙ RZ) ⋙ (integralCompletionCoefficientEquivalence W).mapDerivedCategory.functor ≅
      (integralCompletionCoefficientEquivalence W).mapDerivedCategory.functor ⋙
        integralModuleCompletion ℓ W)
